demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Continuing capacity additions in India's plastics, packaging and textile value chains, and rising per-capita plastic consumption, are expected to sustain demand for masterbatches and compounds.
- The increasing shift toward sustainable and bio-degradable materials is expected to support demand.
- The trajectory of crude-linked input costs is flagged as a key variable to watch.
- Specialty chemicals are expanding faster than bulk chemicals, driven by demand from agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, personal care, electronics and automotive end-uses, and global supply-chain diversification away from China.
- Government initiatives (production-linked incentive schemes, planned dedicated chemical parks, 100% FDI under the automatic route) are expected to support capacity addition and export competitiveness.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continue expanding the product range to meet evolving requirements in both Indian and global markets, with continued emphasis on specialty and sustainable (bio-degradable) product lines.
- Continue regular market reviews and new product development to respond to high competition and price undercutting.
